scope: Same-host reference window and real mixed-file indexing. CPU process time is cumulative; %CPU is lifetime averaged. Owned proc_pid_rusage V2 records sampled physical footprint, physical disk IO and CPU Mach ticks converted using the host timebase; its CPU units were cross-checked against process_time_ns. Unsupported/denied PID reads retain available=false and errno. RSS includes shared resident pages; summed RSS is not unique physical RAM. GPU metrics are best-effort IOAccelerator counters, not energy measurements. No privileged powermetrics, external process arguments, filenames or input contents collected.
